entities.name: Queen Omo of Vesuva
entities.description: Shared name of identical twin shapeshifter sisters who together rule Vesuva on Dominaria.

entities.name: Vesuva
entities.description: Island ruled by Queen Omo, devastated during the Rift Era.

entities.name: Flowstone
entities.description: Mineral Omo can reshape and use as a power source.

entities.name: Rift Era
entities.description: Period during which Vesuva was devastated.

events.summary: The sisters undergo a magical rite, surrendering their names to share a single one as queen.
events.quote: By surrendering their names and assuming a single one, they were bound together

events.summary: They oversee the reconstruction of Vesuva after the Rift Era and maintain its wards.
events.quote: They oversaw the reconstruction of Vesuva after its devastation during the Rift Era

relations.note: The sisters rule the island together.
relations.quote: who together rule the island of Vesuva on Dominaria
